name: @citizen-protocol/typescript-sdk
description: Node.js SDK for submitting signed CITIZEN protocol envelopes and retrieving deterministic receipts.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test dist-test/*.test.js
scripts.release:check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.release:next: npm run release:check && npm publish --tag next
